# Harbor Market demo mailbox

This fictional English mailbox contains 24 messages about setting up a weekend market. It includes replies, an HTML receipt, an inline poster, and image and CSV attachments.

1. Download [Inbox.mbox (19 messages)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/absolroot/Mail-Evidence/main/tests/fixtures/readme-demo/Inbox.mbox) and [Sent.mbox (5 messages)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/absolroot/Mail-Evidence/main/tests/fixtures/readme-demo/Sent.mbox). Open both files together in Mail Evidence.
2. Search for `poster` and open **Harbor Market poster and booth map**. The poster appears below the message. Select `market-stall-map.png` under **Attachments** to preview the booth layout.
3. Clear the search and open **Anomalies**. **Updated Harbor Market artwork** contains four attachment structure findings. Select `invalid-idat.png` and choose **Open full attachment hex** to see the length field at `0x21`. **Loading appointment for Pier 8** shows a From and Reply-To domain difference.

[View the image preview screenshot](../../../docs/media/attachment-preview-dark.png)
